Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers selective Mo6+/Sr2+ doping to tune facet energetics, enabling [001]-oriented quasi-single-crystal Li-rich cathodes. The spatially differentiated dopants couple enhanced Li+ transport with suppressed oxygen release, reducing lattice strain by 47.2% and boosting 5C capacity from 133.6 to 163.1 mAh g−1. This dual-regulation strategy significantly advances high-energy, stable Li-rich battery cathodes.

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The work introduces mass-charge regulatory microdomains in a 3D NiSx-Li anode, simultaneously solving structural and interfacial instability. It partitions Li into ordered domains, dissipates current density, and forms a Li2S/LiF-rich SEI. This coupled design enables 5380 h dendrite-free cycling and 94.1% capacity retention after 1000 cycles, offering a paradigm for durable 3D lithium metal batteries.

💡 Chemically synthesized lithium polysulfide (S@Li₂S) cathodes enable high-performance Li-S all-solid-state batteries. The novelty lies in stabilizing polysulfide species at room temperature in solid state, contradicting prior assumptions. These cathodes show faster kinetics, minimal volume change, and deliver 780 mAh g⁻¹ with 85% retention over 500 cycles—more than double sulfur's capacity—advancing next-generation energy storage.
